instruction: Enable the screen lock feature by turning on 'Lock screen when inactive' in the system settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling screen lock when inactive. The config sets it to false initially, and the task is to set it back to true. Evaluator verifies the setting returns 'true' (newline included).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: Executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.screensaver lock-enabled' which directly extracts the screen lock setting state
Metric logic is correct: Uses exact_match to verify the setting value matches 'true\n', which is the correct output format from gsettings
Complete coverage: The evaluator directly verifies the core requirement (lock-enabled setting is true)
Expected value is correct: 'true\n' correctly includes the newline character that gsettings outputs
State is accessible: gsettings values are persistently stored and accessible without needing UI dialogs to be open
No postconfig needed: The setting can be verified directly via command line without any UI state dependencies
